versions.title: Tide and Moon

skins.name: Nami Tide
skins.story: He fights the way the sea moves, wave after wave, and his foam-white mask has never been seen dry.

skins.name: Tsuki Moon
skins.story: She only duels under a full moon, and the silver disc on her helm is the last light her rivals remember.

skins.name: Hotaru Firefly
skins.story: Nobody sees him in the dark forest arena until the fireflies on his armour light up all at once.

versions.note: Three new samurai step onto the arena at night: a tide warrior with a dorsal-fin crest, a moon guard behind a silver visor and a firefly hunter who glows in the dark.

versions.title: Ashes of the Mountain

skins.name: Kazan Volcano
skins.story: Every hit he takes only cracks his armour wider, and the lava underneath burns hotter for the next round.

skins.name: Kin Gold
skins.story: The golden general laces his armour with crimson cord, one knot for every arena he has won.

skins.name: Iwa Stone
skins.story: A guardian carved from the mountain itself, tied with a sacred rope so he cannot walk away from the fight.

versions.note: The mountain clan joins the fight: a volcano samurai with lava in his cracks, a golden general in crimson lacing and a stone guardian tied with a sacred rope.

versions.title: Spirits of the Shrine

skins.name: Kitsune Fox
skins.story: The shrine fox wears a white mask with red markings, and by the time you see her ears move she has already struck.

skins.name: Hebi Serpent
skins.story: The jade serpent hisses once before every duel, and nobody has ever lasted long enough to hear the second.

skins.name: Karasu Crow
skins.story: The crow samurai drops from the shrine roof with black feathers spread, and his red eyes pick a target before he lands.

versions.note: Three shrine spirits put on armour for the tournament: a white fox in a vermilion mask, a jade serpent with golden fangs and a crow samurai with a sharp orange beak.
